selection: Latest actual provider market_caps observation at or before launch; no interpolation and no current value substituted.
qualification: Retrospectively fetched historical observation, 3 minutes 13.198605 seconds before launch; not an exact launch-instant quote.

providerDocumentation.finding: One-day current lookback has automatic 5-minute granularity; returned market_caps timestamp/value pairs are used without interpolation.
Historical ranges can use hourly granularity. The actual range response returned 24 hourly points, so the one-day market_chart response was used instead.
history is a snapshot at 00:00:00 UTC of the requested date, not an intraday launch-time observation.
CoinGecko announced interval-aligned free-tier historical data from July 23, 2026; historical values can differ after provider corrections, making preservation of this retrieved payload important.
